name: moe_topk_sum
description: In-place MoE sum over the expert axis. x is [M,topk,H]; computes the sum over topk in float32, casts to out.dtype, writes the result into the provided out tensor of shape [M,H], and returns that same out storage. x is read-only. Current tests exercise bfloat16 with topk 2/4/8 and H 1024..7168.
